description: This Java source file defines the LogFragment class, a UI component for displaying logs within an Android application. It creates views to display log data, manages view layout, and updates the scroll position when new logs are added.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android fragment that displays log output using a custom LogView inside a ScrollView.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Initialize and set up the ScrollView and LogView, configure their layout parameters, padding, typeface, and gravity.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates views, sets a TextWatcher on LogView to auto-scroll on new log entries, and returns the top-level view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance used in this fragment for further log management.
